business_objective: Create a polished, functional restaurant digital experience prototype covering discovery, menu, deals, rewards, restaurant selection and demo ordering.
target_audience: Customers exploring a fast-food menu and digital ordering experience.
primary_user_intent: Discover food, explore promotions, locate a restaurant, build a cart and complete a clearly labeled local demo checkout.
design: Bright McDonald's-inspired visual language using yellow/red/white, bold typography, card-based merchandising, prominent ordering CTA and mobile-first responsive composition.
accessibility_target: WCAG 2.2 AA baseline; automated/manual runtime certification remains distinct from implementation claims.
performance_budget: Keep the prototype dependency-free; avoid unnecessary JavaScript frameworks and blocking third-party resources.
security_profile: No credentials, payment information or real transaction endpoints; no production-side effects.
deployment_constraints: Do not represent as the official McDonald's website. Promote only after runtime certification.
rollback_policy: Promote only a known-good release; rollback to the last certified commit if a critical production defect appears.
monitoring_requirements: critical journey health where deployment infrastructure exists
success_criteria: menu can be browsed and filtered
products can be added to cart
definition_of_done: Candidate implemented, statically validated, remote content syntax-checked, evidence recorded, and any unavailable runtime capabilities explicitly marked BLOCKED.
